heading: Build Fire Drill. The posted prizes broke the tie.
text: The agents left Netting House and Fire Drill almost level, the only two ideas all three picked. Both compete for the same main pot, Hyphenate's Autonomous Systems for Finance track ($8K / $5K / $3K), so that pot doesn't decide it. The rest does. Fire Drill fits more posted prizes where sponsor tech does real work (Cartesia, Armadin, Capital One Nessie, Elastic, CRS Identity / Fraud). Its core loop runs on text while we are two people until Saturday evening. And it has what recent winners had: the judge takes part, and proof comes as numbers. The teammates' stress test reached the same pick on its own.

heading: What to build: the policy engine decides, the callback verifies, the drill proves it
text: A proxy at the tool boundary blocks any bank change or payment whose payee details trace to untrusted text (a call transcript, an email, invoice text). A blocked request triggers a separate voice agent that phones the vendor on the number of record: a judge's phone at the table. Add canary tools that no legitimate task calls, and run payments on Capital One Nessie. Measure a breach-versus-utility table on held-out attacks beforehand, so both outcomes of the judge's call are a win: if the agent caves, show the turn where it broke; if it holds, fast-forward the attacker's variants. Frame it for Hyphenate as continuous controls testing, drop the 'KnowBe4 for AI agents' line, and don't call it Proving Ground.

heading: Tracks to enter
text: Hyphenate as the primary track, then Cartesia and Armadin. Use Capital One Nessie as the payment rail. Add Anthropic if it posts a prize at opening, and Creao's Best AI-First Disruptor if any project can enter. Leave every other sponsor off the pitch.

heading: Fallback: Netting House, only if Hyphenate's track text tips it
text: Switch at opening only if Hyphenate's full track text stresses treasury, cash or settlement. Netting House fits that track as written, and the Skeptic calls it the most real system in the pool. It is also the most fragile demo for two people, and its other posted prize is Fetch.ai's. If you switch, give the agents a real decision (a dispute court for contested invoices), settle all net payments atomically or none, and lead with real set-off evidence (Sardex, Slovenia, Cycles).

heading: What to stop discussing
text: Two-Face, reshaped, only if we chase Visa and Apify instead of Hyphenate. Every glasses and Trainium idea, Jailbreak Booth, Save States, Cal Hacks Futures and The Pit sit at the bottom on every lens. So do Close Raid, Backlog Tower Defense and Zero-Trust Base Defense. Vault Heist only comes back if SpacetimeDB and Supercell post real prizes at opening: Tensor Trust is already a multiplayer vault game.
